title: How to Clear the Printer Warning
overview: Help a reviewer support the Clear the Printer Warning step without changing the workflow automatically.
checklist: Follow the printer manufacturer's displayed or documented instructions. Before reaching inside to remove a jam, turn the printer off and unplug it if the manufacturer directs you to do so; internal components can be hot or moving. Do not force paper or touch unfamiliar internal parts.
common_indicators: Record the observed result and return to the originating workflow.

quiz.question: What should you do after completing this support step?
answers: Record the result and return to the workflow
quiz.correct_answer: Record the result and return to the workflow
